(Optional) Get local copy report template customise 5. Render report Edit run (rest can stay example defaults): SampleSet / Subset — experiment name subset label (used title, filenames, output subfolders) FolderDocumentation / FolderData / FolderResults / FolderFigures — absolute (render-time-cwd-relative) paths AnnotationFile — CSV filled Software — fragpipe_dda_combined | fragpipe_dda_individual | diann | peaks_xpro | custom Instrument — tims_tof | faims_orbi | orbi MHCclass — MHC1 (human, 8–13 AA), MHC1_mouse (murine H-2, 7–11 AA) MHC2 (12–25 AA) Provider — lab platform, printed report header; leave empty generic attribution output_file — HTML filename write full parameter reference Parameters section . FolderDocumentation/FolderData/FolderResults/FolderFigures absolute (render-time-working-directory-relative) paths — template ships inside installed package can rendered anywhere. One call renders one report; loop derive_filtered_annotation() multi-subset batch runs (see \dontrun{} example run_howmahico_report). Focused reports (instead --one 00_mhc_report) — build pep_all cache build_pep_all(), render subset smaller, purpose-focused templates (re-parsing per report): focused report chooses obtain pep_all via PepAllSource param: "cached" (default — load <Subset>_pep_all.rda cache), "rda" (load explicit PepAllFile), "build" (parse raw search output , separate build_pep_all() call). render single focused report directly results, pass PepAllSource = "build" (plus Software, AnnotationFile, FolderDocumentation) skip build_pep_all() step . 00_mhc_report (--one) 00_mhc_upsets unchanged still parse raw files . 05_quant_stats compares peptide Area Conditions (normalization, data completeness, PCA clustered/unclustered heatmaps, per-pair differential abundance volcano plots presence/absence track condition-exclusive ligands). uses limma, optional Bioconductor dependency — install BiocManager::install("limma"), render StatMethod = "ttest" (NormMethod = "median") Bioconductor-free run; report falls back automatically limma missing. methods justification documented report .
